verdict_reason: The split of MDM and token-endpoint failures into separate 503 handlers is correct and tested, but the new private helper's name hides that it logs.

todos.issue: The new private helper serviceUnavailable(String logLine, Exception ex) hides a side effect. The name predicts only that it builds a 503 answer, but line 130 also writes the warn line that is the only log of the failure, so a reader of handleMdmUnavailable and handleTokenEndpointUnavailable cannot tell from the call that those handlers log at all.
todos.fix: Must: the helper's name says it both logs the failure and returns the 503 problem detail. One way: rename it to handleServiceUnavailable, matching the handle* methods in this class, which all log and answer.
